_comment: Knobs live here. 'preset' picks a named bundle (balanced | aggressive | growth | us_only | rotation_only | conservative); 'strategy' overrides individual Params fields on top; 'executor' holds runtime limits. Precedence for executor limits: env var (UPPER_CASE) > this file's executor block > the preset's executor block > defaults. Re-run `python backtest.py` after changing anything.

news._comment: Defensive-only news overlay (news_brain.py -> signals/news_risk.json). Can shrink risk or veto up to 3 ETFs for the day; never buys. Scored daily in signals/news_log.json.
